# Library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

load("data/ppi_network/ppi_network_human_v12.rda")

rpws <- read_delim("data/ReactomePathways.txt", col_names = c('pathway_id', 'pathway_name', "organism")) %>% filter(organism == "Homo sapiens")
```

# UKA input

```{r}

source("R/helper.R")

input_folder <- "uka/190117_PERKs"

csuka <- list.files(input_folder, "UKA", recursive = F, full.names = T) %>% lapply(read_csv, id = "path") %>% lapply(function(x) clean_tercen_columns(x)) %>% bind_rows()

csuka$path <- sub(".*NUDUL_(.*)\\.csv.*", "\\1", csuka$path)

csuka$Sgroup_contrast <- paste0(csuka$path, "_", csuka$`Treatment time`)

csuka <- csuka %>% filter(`Treatment time` %in% c(2, 4))

uka <- list.files(input_folder, "^UKA", recursive = F, full.names = T) %>% 
  lapply(read_csv, id = "path") %>% 
  lapply(function(x) clean_tercen_columns(x)) %>% bind_rows()

uka$path <- sub(".*NUDUL_(.*)\\.csv.*", "\\1", uka$path)
uka$TrTime = sub("_T.*", "\\1", uka$Sgroup_contrast)



uka$Sgroup_contrast <- paste0(uka$path, "_", uka$TrTime)

uka <- uka %>% filter(TrTime %in% c(2, 4))


# Clean UKA
# uka <- uka %>% dplyr::rename(Sgroup_contrast = SG_contrast)
unique(uka$Sgroup_contrast)

my_contrasts <- c('_RL vs NU-DUL-1', "_SU-DHL-16 vs RL", "_WSU-DLCL2 vs RL")
my_contrasts <- c("_WSU-DLCL2 vs RL")


uka <- uka %>% filter(Sgroup_contrast %in% my_contrasts)
unique(uka$Sgroup_contrast)

from_vals = unique(uka$Sgroup_contrast)
from_vals
to_vals <- c("armA vs armB")
from_vals
to_vals

uka <- uka %>% 
  mutate(Sgroup_contrast = plyr::mapvalues(Sgroup_contrast, 
                                           from = from_vals,
                                           to = to_vals))



# Make UKA syms vector
uka_syms <- rlang::syms("uka") 


```



# Run kinase network

```{r}
source("R/helper.R")
source("R/kinograte_PG.R")
source("R/kinograte_PG_core.R")
source("R/network_enrichment_and_vis.R")
source("R/plotting_functions.R")

# Name of your results folder
result_path <- paste0("results/",  sub(".*\\/", "", input_folder))
result_path
# make output folder
if (!file.exists(result_path)) {
  dir.create(result_path, recursive = T)
}

# Parameter list - fill it
params <- list(
  spec_cutoffs = c(1), # specificity score, possibly input multiple
  respath = result_path,
  perc_cutoff = 0.01, # single value instead of vector
  rank_uka_abs = T,
  b = 2,
  cs = T,
  highlight_degree = 5,
  min_n_hits = 3,
  art_nodes = NULL, # c("BTK")
  art_lfc = NULL
)

# run this to create networks and pathway csvs
for (uka_sym in uka_syms) {
  params_run <- capture_params(
    !!!params,
    uka = !!uka_sym,
    ppi_network = !!rlang::sym('ppi_networkv12')
  )
  
  do.call(plot_cell_networks_kinase, params_run)
}


result_path <- "results/190117_WilliamsClaire"
# Plot pathway heatmaps from pathway csvs created above
plot_kinase_pathway_heatmaps(result_path)


```

```{r}

source("R/helper.R")
source("R/kinograte_PG.R")

if (!file.exists(result_path)) {
  dir.create(result_path, recursive = T)
}

params <- list(
  spec_cutoffs = c(0.6), # specificity score, possibly input multiple
  respath = result_path,
  control = NULL,
  perc_cutoff = 0.7, # single value instead of vector
  rank_uka_abs = F,
  b = 2,
  cs = F,
  highlight_degree = 5
)

for (uka_sym in uka_syms) {
  params_run <- capture_params(
    !!!params,
    uka = !!uka_sym,
    sens = !!rlang::sym("sens"),
    ppi_network = !!rlang::sym('ppi_networkv12')
  )
  
  do.call(plot_cell_networks, params_run)
}

```

# Run only-kinase-score in parallel
Sequential Dataset Processing with Condition-Level Parallelization 
## Setup

```{r}
# Set up parallel cluster for CONDITION-LEVEL parallelization
# The make_golden_score function will use this cluster internally

setup_condition_parallel <- function() {
  # Clean up any existing clusters first
  if (exists("cl") && !is.null(cl)) {
    tryCatch(stopCluster(cl), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  
  # Set up parallel cluster with PCSF package initialization
  n_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2)
  cat("Setting up cluster with", n_cores, "cores for CONDITION-LEVEL parallelization...\n")
  
  cl <- tryCatch({
    parallel::makeCluster(n_cores)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error creating cluster:", e$message, "\n")
    stop("Failed to create parallel cluster")
  })
  
  cat("Cluster created successfully. Initializing workers for condition processing...\n")
  
  # CRITICAL: Initialize PCSF in each worker (required for Windows C++ functions)
  init_result <- tryCatch({
    parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      library(PCSF)
      library(dplyr)
      library(readr)
      library(tidyr)
      library(purrr)
      library(rlang)
      library(igraph)
      library(data.table)
      
      # Verify PCSF is properly loaded
      if (!exists("PCSF", mode = "function")) {
        stop("Failed to load PCSF in worker")
      }
      
      # Load network data and source files in each worker
      load("data/ppi_network/ppi_network_human_v12.rda")
      source("R/helper_only_kinase_paralell.R")
      source("R/kinograte_PG_only_kinase.R")
      
      # Return success indicator
      return("Worker initialized successfully for condition processing")
    })
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error initializing workers:", e$message, "\n")
    stopCluster(cl)
    stop("Failed to initialize workers")
  })
  
  cat("Worker initialization results:\n")
  print(init_result)
  
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  cat("Parallel backend registered for condition-level parallelization.\n")
  
  return(cl)
}

# Set up the parallel cluster for condition processing
cl <- setup_condition_parallel()

```

## Run
Process datasets sequentially - the parallelization happens INSIDE make_golden_score
```{r}
# Use the parallel version of helper functions for condition-level parallelization
source("R/helper_only_kinase_paralell.R")
source("R/kinograte_PG_only_kinase.R")

# APPROACH: Sequential datasets, parallel conditions within each dataset
# This maximizes CPU utilization without increasing computational workload

# Show how many conditions we have per dataset
for (i in seq_along(uka_syms)) {
  uka_data <- eval(uka_syms[[i]])
  conditions <- unique(uka_data$Sample)
  print(conditions)
  cat("Dataset", i, "(", rlang::as_string(uka_syms[[i]]), "):", length(conditions), "conditions\n")
}


for (uka_sym in uka_syms) {
  cat("\n=== Processing dataset:", rlang::as_string(uka_sym), "===\n")
  
  result <- tryCatch({
    # Use capture_params exactly like the original sequential version
    params_run <- capture_params(
      !!!params,
      cs = if (grepl("uka_cs", uka_sym)) T else F,
      uka = !!uka_sym,
      ppi_network = !!rlang::sym("ppi_networkv12")
    )
    
    # The parallel version of make_golden_score will automatically:
    # 1. Process conditions in parallel (using the cluster we set up)
    # 2. Use parallel_conditions = TRUE by default
    # 3. Maximize CPU utilization across all available cores
    do.call(make_golden_score, params_run)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ERROR processing dataset:", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    cat("✓ Completed dataset:", rlang::as_string(uka_sym), "\n")
    if (!is.null(result$results)) {
      cat("  Generated", nrow(result$results), "result rows\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("✗ Failed dataset:", rlang::as_string(uka_sym), "\n")
  }
}

cat("\nCONDITION-LEVEL PARALLELIZATION COMPLETED!\n")


# Clean up the parallel cluster

if (exists("cl") && !is.null(cl)) {
  stopCluster(cl)
  cat("Parallel cluster stopped successfully.\n")
}

```
